notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1 - BALANCE UPDATE
notes.content:
🦍 Gorilla HP Nerf (Normal Mode)
After numerous reports like “bro you can’t even scratch this thing”, we’ve slightly adjusted the Gorilla’s total health in Normal Mode.

Before: 2000 HP

Now: 1750 HP

🔻 That’s a 12.5% reduction in total HP

This doesn’t mean the Gorilla is now your pet chimpanzee. He’s still an absolute menace — just a tiny bit less unfair.

Good luck. You’ll still need it.
